resource.title: [Jules Task 13] Concurrent Multi-Tenant Fuzzing & Memory Stability Suite
resource.prompt:
Create a concurrent multi-tenant fuzzing and memory stability test suite in tests/test_concurrent_fuzz_memory.js:
1. Concurrently execute 20+ parallel BOQ evaluations across different chassis models (DL380 Gen12, Gen11, MSL3040, Synergy) simultaneously.
2. Assert heap memory stability (process.memoryUsage().heapUsed) to prove zero memory leaks across repeated evaluations and cache lookups.
3. Test race condition safety on shared caches in scripts/lib/sku_versioning.js and scripts/lib/conflict_graph.js.
4. Ensure all tests pass and integrate into npm run test:all.

gitPatch.suggestedCommitMessage:
Add concurrent multi-tenant fuzzing and memory stability test suite

Added `tests/test_concurrent_fuzz_memory.js` to execute 20+ parallel BOQ evaluations across different chassis models. Asserts that heap memory stabilizes to prove zero memory leaks across evaluations and shared cache lookups. Checks for race conditions in `scripts/lib/sku_versioning.js` and `scripts/lib/conflict_graph.js`. Appended the new test to `test:all` script in `package.json`.
